answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in jetty, checked in horizon, and wharf exposes each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 4 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1118 identities would post 2770 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
